 Zelenskyy: Ukrainian forces have struck Russian air defence assets worth US$70m and missile factory
 Roman Petrenko 
 —
 1 November, 12:50
 Photo: Security Service of Ukraine
 Посилання скопійовано 
 Add UP as preferred source in Google 
 President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has reported strikes on a Russian Pantsir-S2 air defence system and a command post vehicle belonging to the S-400 Triumf system with a combined value estimated at around US$70 million. A Russian military facility in Rostov Oblast was also hit. 
 Source: Zelenskyy on X (Twitter) 
 Details: Zelenskyy said Ukrainian forces had struck the Kamensky Plant in Russia's Rostov Oblast, which is involved in missile production. 
 Advertisement: 
 In addition, a Pantsir-S2 air defence gun-missile system and a command post vehicle belonging to the S-400 Triumf system were hit. 
 Zelenskyy noted that the combined value of the air defence assets struck is around US$70 million. 
 The president thanked the Security Service of Ukraine and other units of the defence forces for carrying out the strikes. 
 Background: On the night of 31 October-1 November, Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in four Ukrainian oblasts . As of this morning, hundreds of thousands of households remain without electricity.
